items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: John Collins was a step above us and he used to help. ... from my experience with John I learned a lot because he had been in the company of bigger guys than I had been.

ctx.x:
Well, before that time I'd never been closely associated with any guitar player. Well before I met John I hadn't been closely associated with any guitar players, you know, with the exception of -- well before I met Charley Christian I met John Collins and John Collins was always the studious one. He was always figuring out different variations and changes.

He'd say, 'Hey, look here', cause I played the piano and he'd say, 'Look at this'. He always had some different way of doing things. You know like most of the…

He was older than I and he'd been in heavier company than I had been in and so, therefore, from my experience with John I learned a lot because he had been in the company of bigger guys than I had been. We were all -- you see, the company that I was in was Johnny Clark, Monk, Bud Powers wasn't there yet; he was a young, young kid and hadn't come on the scene yet, and Scottie and all these guys, Ben Harris, Charlie Shavers.
Well, John Collins was a step above us and he used to help.
